lede: Chicago closed Week 8 with a 34-17 win in Seattle and Mark is two clear again on twenty. The structure of Week 9 is worse for Jon than the scoreline: Pittsburgh and Tennessee are both on bye, so he has two games all week, while Mark owns both sidelines in Las Vegas at San Francisco and banks a point before anyone kicks off. Baltimore, meanwhile, has no quarterback and plays Thursday.

beats.tag: Mark · Twenty, and a free point coming
beats.text: Caleb Williams went 24-of-34 for 247 and D'Andre Swift ran in three second-half touchdowns as Chicago won 34-17 at Lumen Field, outscoring Seattle 14-0 after it had been cut to 20-17. Jeffery Simmons, four days after Chicago sent two first-round picks to Tennessee for him, had six tackles, a sack and two tackles for loss in his debut. The Bears are 6-2. And on Sunday the Raiders go to San Francisco, which Mark owns both ends of — a point banked before kickoff.

Pittsburgh and Tennessee are the only two teams on bye in the entire league this week, and Jon has both of them. That leaves Kansas City against Anthony's Jets on Sunday and Buffalo at Minnesota on Monday night — a maximum of two points in a week where Mark is guaranteed at least one and everyone else plays four games. The gap is two. It can only shrink by one, and it could easily grow.

Brian against Mark, and the Ravens have no healthy quarterback. Lamar Jackson is on injured reserve and needs surgery on the thumb he hurt on his only snap against Buffalo; Tyler Huntley is doubtful with turf toe. That leaves Joe Fagnano, an undrafted rookie who went 10-of-21 for 91 in relief on Sunday, took a low hit on his ankle, and was limited in Monday's walkthrough. Baltimore has lost three straight and is a nine-point home underdog — Jacksonville is 5-2 with a top-five offense and defense and the total has dropped six points on the news.

Jon against Harrison to close the week, and it is strength against strength in opposite directions. Minnesota has the league's best scoring defense under Brian Flores and an offense ranked thirtieth in expected points per play. Kyler Murray hurt his hamstring in the loss to Detroit and his status is open — Carson Wentz is the alternative, and the Vikings do not publish an injury report until Thursday. Buffalo is a road favorite by three after the 36-10 win over Baltimore. Harrison also has Washington, Houston and New England, so he plays four to Jon's two.

beats.tag: The pack · Everyone else plays four
beats.text: Bill, Patrick, Brian, Anthony and Zach all have full slates. Bill gets Cincinnati against Brian in Madrid at half past nine in the morning, Dallas at Indianapolis against Patrick, the Giants at Philadelphia against Anthony and Tampa Bay at Chicago on Sunday night against Mark. Zach draws Harrison three separate times. Nobody in the chasing group is more than five and a half points from second, and this is the week to make it up.
